legend.title: Legend
legend.barrier: Barrier: circle size grows with severity; the number is the severity
legend.anchor: Landmark: white circle with a dark ring
legend.demoPath: Demo route: wide purple dashed line with a white edge
legend.coverageDetail: Tap a band to see how many images cover it and whether the coverage comes from real images or seeded demo data
legend.imageOwn: Own photo: magenta circle with a dark ring
legend.imageMapillary: Mapillary image: teal circle with a white ring
legend.imageReport: Report photo: brown circle with a white ring
legend.imageArrow: A black arrow beside the circle points where the camera faced; no arrow means the heading is unknown
legend.routeSamaan: SAMAAN: thick solid blue line with a white edge
legend.routeUnknown: Grey striped overlay: an unchecked stretch of the selected route
legend.routeBarrier: Red ring: a barrier on the selected route; the ring pulses unless reduced motion is on
legend.pendingReport: Pending report: hollow blue circle with a question mark, not yet validated
legend.mission: Mission: thick dashed grey line labelled with the street name
legend.reachWalker: Light blue blob with a solid dark-blue outline: footpaths a walker reaches within the time budget
legend.reachTarget: Purple blob with a dashed outline: footpaths the chosen profile reaches
legend.reachSimulated: Green blob with a dotted outline, drawn on top: the chosen profile's reach once the ticked fixes are applied
legend.reachAnchor: Dark blue star with a white edge and the place name: the start point of the reach
legend.reachFix: Numbered purple pin with a white ring: a barrier from the to-do list; it turns green while its fix is simulated
legend.wheelsVerified: Double line like a rail, green edges with a white core: a footpath a wheelchair rolled over smoothly, verified by wheels
legend.wheelsTraversed: Thin orange-brown line: wheels rolled here, but the ride was too rough or too short to verify it
legend.wheelsJolt: Hollow orange circle with an exclamation mark: a jolt felt by the wheels, a suspected barrier that still needs a photo
legend.routeStandard: Standard: medium dashed grey line with a white edge
legend.userDot: Blue dot with a halo: your GPS position; a white dot with a blue ring is the simulated walk

contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.intro: SAMAAN only knows a footpath is clear if someone looked recently. Photos from your trips keep the map fresh for everyone.

contribute.how: Photos are taken only from your real GPS position, never during a simulated walk, and only while a trip is running.
